svg.title: DOT-Design system context and supported runtime mappings
svg.desc: DOT authors combine capabilities, contracts, anchors, service bindings, configuration, and runtime declarations in dot.json. DOT-Repository co-versions definitions, the generated schema, and high-level skill classifications; dotx validates the reusable definition, and a separate composition pins instances and wires. The dotx lifecycle layer deploys Docker images, Docker Compose, Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, Vagrantfiles, and SHA-256-pinned WebAssembly modules through Wasmtime and WASI.
